faces.transcription: You may immediately turn up to 2 Security tokens faceup in the PEARL Compound. Remove all Checkpoint tokens from the board.
faces.flavor: The exporter proved cooperative once cornered: "I'm not in trouble, am I? I'm just shipping ragweed pollen and seeds. I don't know why they want it, but it's not a crime, right? It's just a weed; it can't really hurt anyone. I'll tell you where the shipment is headed, but that's all I know. I swear."
